findings.title: Prompt-only compaction runs without capturing usage
findings.description: The SDK-session compaction path records telemetry, but `_execute_prompt_only` also invokes `claude_agent_sdk.query` to perform `/compact` and returns without reading result usage or stamping a usage record. Since `COMPACT` is counted as an LLM action by `LLM_ACTION_TYPES` in `src/squadron/stats/usage_report.py`, these calls are reported as unrecorded even when the SDK result contains usage and cost.

findings.title: Malformed `costBasis` can crash the reviews report
findings.description: `_basis` tests `value` against a set of strings. If frontmatter contains an unhashable YAML value, such as a list or mapping for `costBasis`, this raises `TypeError` instead of warning and treating the field as malformed. That contradicts the report’s defensive parsing behavior and can abort `sq stats reviews` for the entire directory.

findings.title: Standalone review stats lose subscription-cost labeling
findings.description: The report reconstructs an alias only from `requestedModel`, but `src/squadron/review/persistence.py` writes that field only when the answering model differs from the requested model. For ordinary reviews where the requested alias answers normally, the alias is absent from the artifact; `stats_views.cost_cell` therefore cannot recognize a subscription alias and labels its provider cost as `prov` rather than `api-rate equiv.`.
